boundaries: The real Translator local run proves exact two-process recovery and full output, not Foundry availability or translation quality.
The Python and .NET deterministic hard-loss runs are fast contract regressions, not the primary long-task proof.
The Foundry Version 7 Translator run proves hosted process replacement and full output on one response; the prior container log was not retained, so exact down time is bounded.
The observer run proves background execution across caller loss; it is not Agent process recovery.
The safe Version 9 run and Portal screenshots prove the post-test deployment, not recovery by themselves.
Graceful Windows shutdown recovery remains NOT_VERIFIED.
